synthesis.procedure: The main article states that the chiral Schiff-base ligand (S)-HL, CoCl₂·6H₂O, GdCl₃·6H₂O, and triethylamine were reacted in mixed methanol and ethanol; it gives no reagent quantities or detailed preparation procedure.
synthesis.time: 1 h reflux; crystals obtained after two weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The refluxed mixture was filtered; brown flake crystals were obtained after two weeks.

properties.summary: Shows UV–visible absorption and circular dichroism; its CD spectrum is approximately the mirror image of 1R. An applied magnetic field changes the CD intensities, and a room-temperature magnetic circular dichroism response is reported.

measurements.name: UV–visible absorption peaks
measurements.conditions: ethanol solution; spectra reported for 0.05 and 0.5 g L⁻¹

measurements.name: magnetic-field-dependent CD and MCD
measurements.value: CD changes under ±1.6 T; MCD observed

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A butterfly-like cationic cluster with a central eight-coordinate GdIII ion and two terminal, six-coordinate CoIII ions. Four Schiff-base ligands bridge the metals through propanediol oxygen atoms, giving a linear Co–Gd–Co core.
